targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.session_date AS time, m.max_weight_lbs
FROM workouts.v_session_exercise_metrics m
JOIN workouts.exercise e ON e.canonical_name = m.canonical_name
WHERE e.include_in_reports
  AND m.canonical_name = '$exercise'
  AND m.max_weight_lbs IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY m.session_date;

SELECT m.session_date AS time, m.progress_score
FROM workouts.v_session_exercise_metrics m
JOIN workouts.exercise e ON e.canonical_name = m.canonical_name
WHERE e.include_in_reports
  AND m.canonical_name = '$exercise'
  AND m.progress_score IS NOT NULL
  AND m.progress_score > 0
ORDER BY m.session_date;
